= Static-site generators (not component-based)

Static-site generators that aren't based on a component framework, including
tools focused on technical documentation and books.

* https://jamstack.org/generators/[Jamstack: List of Static Site Generators]
* https://www.11ty.dev/[11ty]
* https://harpjs.com/[Harp]
* https://hexo.io/[Hexo]
* http://ikiwiki.info/[ikiwiki]
* https://jigsaw.tighten.com/[Jigsaw]
* https://metalsmith.io/[Metalsmith]
* https://middlemanapp.com/[Middleman]
* https://retype.com/[Retype]
* https://artik-man.github.io/SamuraiJS/[SamuraiJS]
* https://github.com/sculpin/sculpin[Sculpin]
* https://gohugo.io/[Hugo]
